text:
maria: noticing a surge in central audit PUTs since ~03:10 UTC and several ap-south GPU nodes failing to join. KMS decrypts returning AccessDenied with aws:SourceVpce condition.

 taylor: did infra roll anything last night?

 sasha: yes, keystore policy tightened to require SourceVpce/SourceVpc for decrypts (INFRA-1742).

 jordi: control-plane uses regional privatelink endpoints; looks like ap-south's VPCE rotated and isn't listed in the policy. nodes call Decrypt via control-plane and get denied.

 maria: stack snippet: `AccessDeniedException: Condition check failed: aws:SourceVpce` from keystore client.

 ops-bot: Incident IR-2026-091 opened. Priority P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/keystore-onboard

 taylor: mitigation plan: 1) add current control-plane VPCE id for ap-south to keystore allowlist 2) throttle debug-level audit shipping to central 3) apply short lifecycle to central debug/ prefix 4) requeue failed nodes with extended STS expiry.

 sasha: I reverted the audit-forwarder routing for debug/ back to staging and reduced debug QPS from 1800->250.

 jordi: applied targeted policy patch to allow arn:aws:ec2:ap-south-1::vpce/vpce-zzzz9999 for the control-plane principal. requeued nodes; 6/8 succeeded, remaining two expired STS tokens and will retry.

 maria: applied S3 lifecycle: expire debug/ after 5 days.

 taylor: post-mitigation actions: (A) create a deploy canary that verifies keystore Decrypt via each region VPCE on policy changes, (B) automation to append new control-plane VPCE ids during region bootstrap, (C) add audit-forwarder integration tests. Assign owners.

 ops-bot: IR-2026-091 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Attachments: node list, policy-diff, cost snapshot.

 maria: summary: keep VPC/VPCe restriction in place; use targeted allow for control-plane endpoints and automate whitelist. Postmortem owners: jordi + sasha. Ping me if more onboards fail.
